name: Kispesti Uszoda és Sportközpont

scheduleSource.note: BEST-IN-CLASS LANE DATA, but published as a PNG, not HTML. The page 'Sávbeosztás' (menu slug is misleadingly /pentek-ebihal/) embeds a fortnightly PNG whose URL follows a stable, predictable pattern: https://kispestiuszoda.hu/wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/Savbeosztas-WEB-YYYY.MM.DD-MM.DD.png (verified example: .../2026/09/Savbeosztas-WEB-2026.09.28-10.04.png, and the page also showed the prior 2026.09.21-09.27 sheet). A scraper should GET the page and regex the under the 'Sávbeosztás' heading rather than construct the URL. IMAGE STRUCTURE (it is a rendered Excel grid, so OCR/pixel-sampling is viable and the geometry is stable): two side-by-side week panels, each headed 'Érvényes: YYYY.MM.DD-MM.DD.'. Each panel has two stacked tables: upper = 'Medence 33 M', lower = 'Tanmedence'. Header rows: 'Nap / Day' (Hétfő/Monday .. Vasárnap/Sunday), 'Dátum / Date', then 'Sáv / Lane' with lane numbers 1-6 repeated per day = 42 columns. Row labels are hourly timeslots 06:00-07:00 through 20:00-21:00 (15 rows). Cell colour is the payload: GREEN = 'Lakosság számára elérhető' (available to the public), RED = 'Foglalt / Zárva' (reserved or closed). Footnote warns green lanes are shared public lanes, not exclusive, and can be crowded. This maps 1:1 onto the app's 'how many lanes are free in a timeslot' question: count green cells per (basin, day, hour).

notes: Lane counts (6 per basin) read directly off the official sávbeosztás grid, which enumerates lanes 1-6 for both the 33 m pool and the tanmedence. Tanmedence length not stated on the site, left null. Outdoor summer basins exist (see /kulteri-medencek-nyitvatartas/) but are seasonal and not lane-marked, so omitted. Coordinate: OSM node/way at 1191 Simonyi Zsigmond utca 31 cross-checked against the address printed in the site footer and on /kapcsolat/ — exact match.
